transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... for months now, I’ve been trying to get people to understand what's going on. It's my husband’s family. They've been quietly messing with our money and our good name. 

I see it happening all the time. Like, I work in billing, and these little billing errors will just show up at work out of nowhere. Or someone at church will suddenly act funny toward me for no reason. People try to tell me I'm wrong, but no matter what records anyone pulls up to try and explain it away, I just know it ties back to them.
Have you ever seen, heard, or sensed things that others don't seem to notice, like voices or visions?

No, no, I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. Nothing like that. I'm completely in my right mind. I just notice the things that are actually happening right in front of me, like the billing errors and the way people look at me. It's real life, not my imagination.
Have you ever experienced a period where you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or irritable for several days or more, where it was different from your usual self?

No, I haven't had anything like that. I'm pretty steady, honestly. I go to work, I go to church, I do what I need to do. I don't get overly energetic or... or irritable for no reason. I mean, I get frustrated when I see what my husband's family is doing, but that's just a normal reaction to people messing with your life. It's not because my mood is all over the place.
Have you ever had times when you felt so good or so irritable that people around you noticed a change in your behavior, even if it didn't last very long?

No, not at all. I mean... no one has ever come up to me and said I was acting out of character or anything like that. I just feel like my regular self every day. I don't have times where I'm suddenly on top of the world or snapping at everyone around me for no reason. It's just... normal everyday life for me.
Do you ever feel like people are trying to send you hidden messages or that certain events have a special meaning specifically for you, even if others don't see it that way?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I don't look for hidden messages in things. I just... I see what's happening right in front of me. Like I said, the things I notice are real, like the issues with the bills or the way my husband's family acts. It's not like the TV is talking to me or... or anything strange like that. I just pay attention to what people actually do.
Do you believe, without doubt, that your husband's family is intentionally trying to harm you or ruin your life, even if you can’t fully explain how or why they’re doing it?

Yes, I do. Honestly, that's really why I'm here. For months now, I've been trying to get people to understand what they're doing. They are quietly messing with our money and our good name. It's... it's subtle things. Like, I'll see little billing errors show up at my work, or someone at my church will suddenly act funny toward me, like they've been told something. And I know it ties back to his family. People try to pull up records or tell me it's just a mistake, but I know what's happening. I know they're behind it.
Even when people show you records or explain the billing errors as simple mistakes, do you still believe, without a doubt, that your husband’s family is behind these things?

Yes, absolutely. I mean, I know what I'm seeing. People try to show me the paperwork or say it's just a clerical error, but... well, I'm a billing clerk. I know how these things work. These aren't just random mistakes. It's happening too often, and it always seems to affect me directly. And it's not just the bills. Like I said, it's the way people at church look at me, like they've heard rumors. No matter what anyone tries to tell me, or what records they pull up, I know his family is behind it. They are trying to ruin our finances and my reputation, and I just can't get anyone to see it.
